alt: First page of the OIG/HHS Healthcare Fraud report summary and complainant instructions.
summary: This document is the initial page of a formal Healthcare Fraud report submitted to the Office of Inspector General (OIG) for the Department of Health Care Services (HHS). It contains crucial instructions regarding the complaint review process, investigator contact protocols, and information on how to request records under the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA). In the context of the audit, this page establishes the formal commencement of a federal-level reporting action against L.A. Care's administrative practices, illustrating the member's utilization of all available oversight channels.
full_text:
Requesting information about your
complaint

Every report we receive is important, however, not every submission
results in an investigation.

Once submitted, we will review your complaint for relevance and
completeness. If you have identified yourself, a reviewing official may
contact you for further information. It is important to note that you might
not be contacted by an investigator but that does not mean your complaint
is not being investigated. Due to the high volume of complaints we receive,
it is not possible to contact every complainant. The Hotline will not be able
to confirm receipt of your complaint or respond to any inquiries about
action taken on your complaint.

You may request information about your complaint through the OIG
Freedom of Information Act officer (https://oig.hhs.gov/foia). Remember to
phrase your request in terms of a search for records pertinent to your
complaint, not status. You should wait at least six months before filing
such a request.

Your complaint summary

Before you submit, make sure you check your information and save or print a copy
for your records.
